🎄 Hotel McCoy Holiday Vendor Market

Friday, December 11 | 6–10 PM

Twinkling lights, cozy cocktails, local vendors, and a courtyard full of holiday cheer ✨

Join us at Hotel McCoy in South College Station for a festive evening of shopping small, supporting local creatives, and enjoying live music under the lights. Browse handmade goods, holiday gifts, art, and more from small businesses around the area.

🎶 Original music in the courtyard

🍷 wine, beer & spirits

🌙 Festive outdoor evening market atmosphere

💛 Free to attend

Family friendly • Dog friendly
